items.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
items.summary: Intrinsic Distribution Matching improves few-step text-to-image generation by adding explicit moment constraints to distribution matching distillation, achieving state-of-the-art long-text rendering with minimal network evaluations.

items.title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
items.summary: Youtu-Parsing-Omni is a unified multi-modal parser that encodes documents, images, audio, and video into structured spatiotemporal records using shared weights and cross-modal fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results across parsing benchmarks through a self-evolving on-policy distillation procedure.

items.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
items.summary: A-RSI improves recursive self-improvement by refreshing training tasks based on declining learning signals and using independently verifiable program-generated answers, raising benchmark performance without external labels.

items.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
items.summary: This work formalizes benchmark evaluation through difficulty measures, identifies failure modes of measure mismatch and coverage gaps, and proposes diagnostic metrics and a rewriting algorithm to improve benchmark coverage.

items.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
items.summary: LOWN adaptively skips image processing during diffusion vision-language model decoding when predictions agree, reducing computation while preserving accuracy.

items.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
items.summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures trained on aligned multi-modal observations converge to shared representations with far greater efficiency than next-token prediction, demonstrating that positive view design—not scale alone—drives cross-modal alignment.

items.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
items.summary: L3G-World uses a compact latent 3D Gaussian memory and alternating autoregressive updates with a video diffusion transformer to generate spatially consistent interactive worlds in real time.

items.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
items.summary: SpecSlot improves pixel-space generative Transformers by using localized spectral slots and restricted global attention to increase image detail without raising computational cost.

items.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
items.summary: Falcon is a lightweight causal audio-visual target speaker extraction method that achieves high quality with drastically reduced parameters and latency, supported by the realistic RealSSA benchmark.

items.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
items.summary: OmniShowcase improves subject-to-video generation by using geometry-driven training data and surface-normal conditioning to maintain 3D consistency across novel viewpoints.

items.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
items.summary: TAO improves scheduling for LLM agent services by considering tool readiness and using dynamic programming to place sessions, reducing latency and increasing throughput.

items.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.summary: Sensorimotor alignment measures how sensory representations match physical motion geometry, serving as a low-cost offline predictor of robot model performance.

items.title: OmniSpectra: A Unified Foundation Model for Universal Spectra Representation Learning
items.summary: OmniSpectra is a wavelength-native spectral foundation model that uses continuous coordinates and physics-grounded decoders to learn cross-instrument representations without destructive resampling, achieving high performance with far fewer parameters.

items.title: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
items.summary: ChronoReplay mitigates interface lock-in in spatial vision-language models by replaying heterogeneous spatial supervision chronologically, improving cross-task transfer and enabling efficient inference-time evidence selection.

items.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
items.summary: The Trinity framework recursively improves multimodal agents by organizing tasks into a capability tree, generating simulated training worlds, and routing specialized harness modules to boost performance on diverse benchmarks.

items.title: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.summary: Multiscale Policy Optimization improves long-horizon agent training by aligning credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale.

items.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
items.summary: Large-scale evaluation reveals that dedicated memory systems often underperform naive retrieval-augmented generation, introducing a framework of memory benefit and memory tax to assess net value.

items.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
items.summary: PDRVLA improves robot action generation by integrating a lightweight physical dynamics module that predicts future visual features with world-model supervision, avoiding online video generation latency.

items.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
items.summary: Hy-Nomas is a video world model that uses causal attention and structured conditioning to generate interactive, multi-turn video segments with text and camera control.

items.title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
items.summary: Test-Time Memory Evolution updates external memory without changing model weights to guide scientific discovery more efficiently than test-time training.

items.title: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
items.summary: HABIT-Bench evaluates whether LLM agent memory systems can infer implicit user habits from sparse dialogue evidence and apply them correctly across long-term interactions.

items.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
items.summary: Trajectory2Gym improves tool-use training by constructing interactions with compositional coverage and decision grounding rather than collecting successful trajectories.

items.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
items.summary: TraceTrial-Bench evaluates agent harness reliability across seven components using mechanism-oriented tasks, trajectory tracing, and failure attribution to compare harness designs and diagnose failures.

items.title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
items.summary: StreamVibe introduces a benchmark, streaming vision-language model, and hierarchical memory harness to enable proactive, intent-aware interaction with implicit and evolving user goals.

items.title: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
items.summary: DynaFlow enables adaptive multi-agent collaboration by letting a main agent synthesize executable workflows that coordinate sub-agents through structured execution and verification.

items.title: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
items.summary: InteractiveWorld provides a verifiable simulation environment and benchmark to evaluate whether multimodal language models can reliably guide humans through physical tasks.

items.title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
items.summary: The paper proposes a unified framework for work agents that integrates foundation models with runtime harnesses to execute complex digital tasks reliably, introducing dimensions of persistence and openness alongside capability families and evaluation metrics.

items.title: Representation Redistribution in Sparse Autoencoders
items.summary: Sparse autoencoders decompose language model activations into sparse features, and the redistribution sensitivity score identifies recurring feature changes that contribute to downstream readout failures without equating representation change with failure.

items.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
items.summary: A new benchmark evaluates whether LLM agents improve through repeated professional tasks with feedback, revealing limited sustained learning in current frontier models.

items.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
items.summary: This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.

items.title: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
items.summary: Function-Space Policy Optimization improves reasoning and tool-use accuracy by combining temporal consolidation with privileged adaptation, reducing memory use and outperforming baselines.

items.title: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
items.summary: UserArena introduces a real-world interactive benchmark with long-horizon shopping trajectories and an evaluation framework, alongside On-Policy Trajectory Distillation to improve simulator fidelity for agentic recommendations.

items.title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
items.summary: HiSTEVE is a hierarchical vision-language-action agent that combines long-horizon planning with native keyboard-and-mouse control to perform complex open-ended tasks in Minecraft.

items.title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
items.summary: RynnUnify is a 16B unified embodied model that integrates visual planning, physical reasoning, and robot control, achieving state-of-the-art results on long-horizon embodied tasks.

items.title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
items.summary: RSIHub is an open-source framework that standardizes agent-evolution research by providing shared infrastructure for building, comparing, and extending methods with reusable components and consistent evaluation.

items.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
items.summary: Foundation models can self-improve across text and vision tasks by generating synthetic questions and reasoning traces guided only by high-level topics, without external supervision.

items.title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
items.summary: Omni-Woodpecker is a training-free framework that reduces cross-modal hallucinations in omni LLMs by identifying modality conflicts and rebalancing hidden representations to suppress misleading priors.
